verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an open-source, dependency-free C/C++ inference engine you can build from source and run locally. It works with GGUF model files pulled from Hugging Face, so the evidence implies little vendor lock-in around models and runtime. However, nothing in the pack documents an export feature for user data such as web UI chat history or sessions. Missing for 10: any documented export of user data (e.g. chats or sessions from the built-in web UI), explicit statement that GGUF is an open, documented format, and independent confirmation of data portability.
